title: Earlier work, 2021 to 2024
line: molecular deep learning, MD simulations, a pegRNA tool, clinical NLP
items: chemception-style CNN on molecule images, retargeted to a hepatotoxicity endpoint (2022). the image encoder and inception scaffold come from a published tutorial; the dataset, the endpoint and the GPU port are mine.

molecular dynamics of two peptides in GROMACS with CHARMM36, energy minimisation through NVT and NPT to a 10 ns production run (2022). the analysis notebook is adapted from a public teaching lab; the trajectories are my own runs.
a pegRNA design tool for prime editing, interactive at the command line, with its own validation messages for spacer, PBS and RTT lengths (2024). written from scratch.
clinical NLP on national survey data: NAMCS visit records wrangled against hand-built ICD and RxNorm lookup tables, plus a parser for the n2c2 de-identification ground truth (2024).
multi-omics cohort analyses across proteomics and metabolomics studies (2024 to 2025), the work behind the multi-omics line on my resume.
writing came first: two ChEMBL and Keras write-ups on inhibiting the hepatitis C polyprotein (2021), the oldest machine-learning-on-chemistry thing I have.
calls: kept on the site as one card, not six. it is range and persistence, not six separate claims.
authorship stated per item. where a public tutorial supplied the scaffold, it says so, and what is mine is named.
broke: most of it was never version controlled. the omics folder has a git directory with no commits in it at all, so there is no history to point at.
part of the clinical NLP annotation set is sitting as empty cloud placeholders rather than real files.
not_shown: no links: none of this is in a public repo yet
two things I remembered doing, flux balance analysis and Qiskit quantum chemistry work, are not on this machine or its clouds
